article_limitations: Disposition aggregate_only: the source reports fifteen patients (fifteen eyes) with ocular toxoplasmosis only as a retrospective series of OCT finding counts and percentages; no patient has individual identity evidence, so no individual patient records are created and series statements are not copied to placeholder patients.
reported_individual_count is 15 (literal) and roster_complete is false because none of the fifteen stated individuals can be enumerated.

Source inconsistency on case numbers: the Results text says seven active lesions and five retinochoroidal scars were studied, while Table 1 is titled 13 active cases and Table 2 is titled 11 scars, and the Methods say fifteen eyes of fifteen patients with active ocular toxoplasmosis; these are not reconciled.

Source inconsistency on proportions: Table 1 and Table 2 print proportions such as 13/13 as 86,6% and 11/11 as 73,3%, which match a denominator of 15 rather than the stated 13 and 11; the abstract repeats 86,6% and 73%. Not corrected.

Table 2 leaves the cells for hyper-reflective dots in the vitreous cavity and for an attached posterior hyaloid as a bare underscore with no proportion; these are not recorded as zero or as negative findings.

The study is described as SS-OCT in the aim, methods and conclusion, while the title and highlights say spectral or SD-OCT; the Discussion also describes earlier SD-OCT work. The imaging device is not attributed to any individual.
Methods state one patient had amblyopia, two had hypertension and two had diabetes; these are cohort counts and are not assigned to any individual.
Figures 1 and 2 show unidentified members of the series; ownership is unresolved and they are not attributed to a patient. Pixels were reviewed in the separate visual target.
The supplement mmc1.docx is a PROCESS reporting checklist (administrative); it carries no patient data.
